planets.name: K2-3 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-3 with a 24.6-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: K2-3 c was found in 2015 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-3. Its orbit and size follow Diamond-Lowe et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
